name: Daily Business Report
description: Fetch a normalized daily business snapshot and deliver one concise Telegram report in English or Vietnamese with optional AI commentary.

params.system_message: You summarize business metrics. Be concise, factual, and never invent numbers or causes that are not in the supplied data.
params.prompt: Write at most 3 short sentences highlighting what needs attention.
